selection_log: Failed retrievals stay in the pool and are not replaced.
BLS and CDC responses were access-denied pages. Those URLs were not retried with a different client.
The first explicit in-scope relation in each retrieved source is paired with one inverse.
A second explicit later relation was included for S08, S10, S11, S12, S13, and S14 so the fresh cohort could meet the requested real-case floor without adding sources.
Single-series changes and side-by-side figures without a stated comparison were skipped.
S14's first sentence was split by the extractor on the abbreviation U.S. The passage is the whitespace-collapsed extract of that sentence.
S16's first in-scope relation is event order. A later 'different than' contrast is not a magnitude comparison.
